overview: This website extends the native graphite and Noto Sans system recorded in the root DESIGN.md. The native editor remains the authority for the application; this document records the web reading and download surface. Graphite fills and square edges carry through, while the website uses a muted pink accent for links, focus, active navigation, and platform detection.

The overview keeps the message short, puts the current release identity and three platform downloads before an uncropped image of the actual player, and then points to installation, support evidence, and the roadmap. The documentation pages use the same wordmark, navigation, and footer so technical detail stays part of one site.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite surfaces with thin dividers and quiet neutral text.
A restrained pink accent that marks interaction and partial support.
A bundled Noto Sans face and square page controls.
The real player screenshot as the main product proof, followed by practical reference pages.

rules.name: The Native System Extension Rule
rules.body: Preserve the native editor's graphite, Noto Sans, square-edge identity; apply website-specific type scale and responsive reading layout only to this web surface.

rules.name: The Pink Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the website's pink accent for interaction, active state, focus, and partial support; do not turn it into a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Graphite Continuity Rule
rules.body: Keep the shared graphite palette as the page foundation and let the actual application image supply its own color.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Keep the bundled Noto Sans for the site's normal text and avoid adding a second display face.

rules.name: The Download First Rule
rules.body: Keep the release identity and all three platform choices ahead of the large player image.

rules.name: The Visible Scope Rule
rules.body: Preserve the support table's feature, status, and full scope text in its mobile layout.

rules.name: The Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: Use tonal fills, spacing, and hairlines for hierarchy; keep cards on the same plane as the page.

rules.name: The Square Edge Rule
rules.body: Keep controls and containers rectangular; reserve the accent outline for an actual selected or focused state.

rules.name: The Real Player Rule
rules.body: Let the actual application screenshot carry the product's visual detail; keep the surrounding web chrome quiet.

rules.name: The Evidence Stays Open Rule
rules.body: Keep support status and its scope visible in each row, including at mobile widths.

dos: Do keep the website an extension of the native graphite and Noto Sans system.
Do lead the overview with the current release and all three platform downloads.
Do use the real, uncropped player screenshot as product proof.
Do keep installation guidance, support detail, and roadmap sections available through the shared page shell.
Do retain the visible scope and gaps beside support statuses on every screen size.
donts: Don't create a separate palette, rounded-card system, or shadow-heavy layer.
Don't replace the player screenshot with stock artwork or a fabricated interface.
Don't use the pink accent as a large background or as a compatibility success color.
Don't hide support gaps behind hover, tooltips, or mobile-only horizontal scrolling.
Don't describe roadmap sections as collapsible; the shipped page presents them as headings and prose.
